summary: Batuna Aerodrome is a small airfield serving the Batuna Mission Station in the Western Province of the Solomon Islands. It provides essential air access to remote communities on New Georgia and surrounding islands, where road and sea transport can be limited. The airport primarily supports regional flights and missionary operations in this isolated Pacific location.
